description: Returns one shipped workflow chart template by key (see list_workflow_templates), with the child workflows it calls, every question it can ask (each `prompt.id`, with its options) and every way it can end, and the API calls that install and run it. Its whole usage contract, with example webhooks and answers, is GET /api/v2/workflow-templates/{key}/usage.md (or /usage for JSON), readable before anything is installed. Unmodified, install it with POST /api/v2/workflow-templates/{key}/install (body {"publish": true}), which installs its child workflows too ("replace": true re-installs over the ones the app already has); adapted (check with validate_workflow_chart), install it with PUT /api/v2/workflows/{key} (publish: true), each child first. Then run it with POST /api/v2/connections/{connection_id}/workflow-runs with an `input` matching the chart's declared inputs, on a realtime or simulated connection: a standard one answers 422 with errors.code realtime_required and nothing stored, so the same call starts the run once the connection is upgraded. An installed workflow is a copy: when the template changes later, GET /api/v2/workflows/{key} says so in template.status (update_available), and installing it again with "replace": true takes the new version.
name: get_workflow_template
title: Get workflow template
